# LokTube 2.0.1

- Restore the YouTube guest homepage in incognito, including generic discovery videos and Shorts.
- Hide account sign-in prompts on the private homepage.
- When the anonymous player API asks for sign-in, try the public signed-out watch page once with that page's own playback response, visitor and attestation token.
- Preserve YouTube's actual playback restrictions and show an incognito-specific message if signed-out playback is still declined.
- Incognito continues to use no connected account cookies and records no watch or search history.
